gist: A Brazilian youth football match resulted in a world record 51 red cards.
The game was abandoned following a mass brawl involving players and coaching staff.
Uberlandia conceded the second leg to allow Mamore to progress to the final.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: A semi-final under-20s match between Uberlandia and Mamore in Brazil was abandoned after 51 red cards were issued. A brawl began in the second half when a player taunted the opposing bench, leading to confrontations involving players and staff. The referee halted the game for 40 minutes before abandoning it due to the scale of the disorder and damage caused to the stadium.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The incident set a new world record for red cards in a single match, surpassing the previous record of 36. Significant damage was reported at the Parque do Sabia Stadium, including broken doors, windows, and furniture, requiring the intervention of military police.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Uberlandia has conceded the second leg of the semi-final, citing a gesture of fair play because Mamore lacks sufficient available players. Mamore will advance to the final, while Uberlandia will compete in the third-place match.

gist: Fenerbahce defeated Liverpool 3-2 in a Champions League match held in Istanbul.

Interim manager Dirk Kuyt led Fenerbahce to victory before stepping down from his role.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Liverpool lost 3-2 to Fenerbahce in Istanbul after conceding three goals from set-pieces. Despite taking the lead twice through Trey Nyoni and Alexander Isak, Liverpool failed to maintain their advantage. Fenerbahce, managed by interim boss Dirk Kuyt, secured the win with goals from Mason Greenwood, Archie Brown, and Vedat Muriqi.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The defeat represents a significant setback for Liverpool, who have now lost twice in four days. It is the latest point in a major European game that Liverpool have led before losing. For Fenerbahce, the result is a historic victory against an English side, providing a morale boost during a difficult season.

gist: Esteban Ocon was dropped by Haas for the rest of the season after a falling-out.
The decision follows a history of team friction and being outperformed by team-mates.
Ocon now faces a period on the sidelines with little prospect of returning.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Esteban Ocon was dropped by Haas following a disagreement with team principal Ayao Komatsu after practice in Mexico City. Ocon had objected over the radio to a tyre strategy change. While L'Equipe reported the meeting ended physically, Ocon categorically rejected any physical violence.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Ten years into his Formula 1 career, Ocon has a reputation for friction with teams and team-mates. Having been outperformed by team-mates like Oliver Bearman, and with new talent emerging, this departure may signal the end of his Formula 1 career.

articles.standfirst: Chris Sutton and Ian McCall weigh in on Celtic after a second league defeat of the season, but manager Martin O'Neill is defiant.

gist: Celtic suffered a surprise defeat to Falkirk, marking their sixth loss in ten matches.
Pundits and fans raised concerns over team regression, aging players, and squad tactics.
Despite recent poor form, manager Martin O'Neill noted Celtic remain top of the Premiership.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Celtic lost a Scottish Premiership match to Falkirk, recording their sixth defeat in ten matches across all competitions. Despite dominating possession and shots, Celtic failed to secure a win, following a draw against Dundee United.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The defeat allowed rivals to close the gap at the top of the table. Pundits and fans questioned the team's direction, citing injuries, player aging, and tactical confusion under manager Martin O'Neill.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Celtic face a crucial home match against Besiktas in the Europa League, which they need to win to keep progression hopes alive after starting the competition with three defeats.

fivew: Celtic experienced a defeat against Falkirk amid a run of poor form.
Deficiencies across the team and a toll of age and injury on key players were cited.

quotes.text: Martin's not going to say it, of course, but the club is in regression, the team is in regression
This time last year, we were in a worse position.
